raw_segments.text: Yes, I will M, she said, trembling. But oh, I just wanted to arse you. Miss Sarah, she's
been such a rich young lady, and she's been waited on, and in foot. And what will she
do now, Mum, without no maid? If, oh, please, would you let me wait on her after I've done
my pots and kettles? I'd do him that quick if you'd let me wait on her now she's poor.
Oh, breaking out afresh, poor little Miss Sarah, Mum that was called a princess.
